test_adaptive_delay_for_near_limit_chunk: test DiscordAdapter uses a longer delay when a chunk is near the 2000-char platform limit
test_shield_protects_handle_message_from: test asyncio.shield prevents handle_message cancellation from a follow-up chunk arriving mid-flight
test_matrix_split_messages_aggregated: test two rapid messages from the same Matrix room are merged into one aggregated message
test_matrix_different_rooms_not_merged: test messages from different Matrix rooms are dispatched as separate batches
test_wecom_split_messages_aggregated: test two rapid messages from the same WeCom chat are merged into one aggregated message
test_telegram_short_chunk_uses_normal_de: test TelegramAdapter uses normal batch delay for short text chunks
test_telegram_near_limit_chunk_uses_spli: test TelegramAdapter uses a longer delay when a chunk is near the 4096-char limit
test_telegram_split_continuation_merged: test a near-limit chunk followed by continuation text is merged into one message
